sources.reason: Short-lived job, total timeout, cancel/kill/join. Replace unbounded communicate and parent-only kill with bounded stream counters, cgroup kill/quiescence and namespace/seccomp isolation. No silence timeout.
Pickle, caller-selected import paths and raw exception forwarding violate the scoped protocol. New closed JSON, exact profiles, staged files and redacted machine codes instead.

Upstream option fallback, unbounded line read and Markdown-only success do not qualify canonical IR or sandbox. Keep only an unqualified Docling2.148.0 descriptor; implementation/model BOM/PDF/OCR qualification belongs to later parser items.

Adapt timeout/cancellation/terminal-result regressions to real bwrap+seccomp+cgroup and strict JSON. Add flood, descendant, OOM, stale identity, path and unavailable-capability negatives; no importorskip on mandatory backends.

sourceGaps.gap: No donor implements the approved strict staged JSON plus Linux sandbox boundary.
sourceGaps.resolution: New offline runtime builder/BOM, descriptor-relative worker I/O, seccomp/network isolation and cgroup v2 limits. Existing KnowKit schemas and PHP JCS/semantic/ProcessingIdentity/JobQueue implementations are reused.

sourceGaps.gap: Docling/PDF/OCR model qualification and PHP resource import/publication orchestration are separate items.
sourceGaps.resolution: Capabilities stay false/unavailable. Synthetic fixture parser is injected only into disposable test runtimes. Verified bundle exposes no acceptance/publication operation; real PostgreSQL tests exercise the existing conditional fence/lease gate.

qualification.goldenRationale: Initial authored protocol corpus 1.0.0: synthetic UTF-8 input and integer-only RFC8785 IR/result, independently calculated with Python hashlib and verified by PHP core contracts. Future expected digest changes require a fixture version and semantic rationale, never a blind snapshot rewrite.
securityRegressions: Early cancellation before cgroup attachment kills/reaps the trusted launcher within a bound.
Real sandbox regression with an open PHP metadata canary verifies inherited host FDs and credential environment do not enter the worker.
